topicName: What is the purpose of the 'final' keyword?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is the purpose of the 'final' keyword?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'final' keyword in Java is a non-access modifier used to apply restrictions on a variable, method, or class. It signifies that the entity it modifies cannot be changed or overridden."}]
